purpose: Add independent battery families and temperature-dependent cell models without changing frozen earlier scientific artifacts.
roles: Whole source tests are the split unit. CSV duplicates retain the same role as their MAT test. No reserved data may be decoded for fitting or model selection.

method.model: SOC-temperature lookup OCV plus positive RC dynamics; model complexity selected on calibration data only.
method.capacity_coordinate: Conserved charge referenced to a fixed identified capacity; do not change SOC merely by changing temperature.
method.electrical_temperature: Use measured cell temperature when identifying dependence; chamber labels are conditions, not the cell temperature measurement.
method.thermal: Identify heat-transfer parameters only from predeclared calibration evidence, or retain their declared-assumption status.
method.domain: Use supported model/state domains. Ambient temperature is a thermal boundary condition, not an electrical-model lookup coordinate.
method.numerical: Conservation, exact constant-parameter limits, event handling, refinement and independent single-cell reference checks precede empirical assessment.

proposed_application_error_budget.status: Predeclared research-prototype target, not a manufacturer rating or universal engineering acceptance.

assessment_rule: Use only records explicitly selected by the frozen assessment procedure. Freeze model, code, procedure, preprocessing, scoring, initialization, source and runtime before reserved access. The six allocated UDDS records remain reserved; they are not an instruction to open all six. Failure is retained; no refit against final traces under this version.

sources.name: Imperial PyECN Cylindrical_Cell1
sources.role: Published whole-cell electrical parameter import; not independent experimental validation
